title: Accepting final scan
statement: Let $m>0$, let $����$, $a_0$, and $����$ be fixed, and let $j<m$ be the final field index, so $j+1=m$. Let $a$ be a state and $w$ a word such that the acceptance predicate holds on the state obtained by folding $w$ from $a$. Let $d$ be a configuration in the forward scan state with value $a$, whose tape $0$ agrees with the buffer for $w$ at every relative integer position from $-1$ through $|w|$. After $2|w|+3$ steps, the round machine is in the exit state, with all other configuration data unchanged. At every earlier time $u<2|w|+3$, its state is neither the read state with no stored Boolean value nor the exit state. Throughout every time $u\le 2|w|+3$, the head on tape $0$ stays between its initial position minus one and its initial position plus $|w|$, inclusive; the head on tape $1$ remains fixed.
